Upon arriving at the police department, it becomes very apparent why this man was trying to conceal his identity. After fingerprinting, he was identified as Frank Ortiz, who had an active warrant for receiving and possessing a stolen vehicle. During the search, a substance resembling a small white rock was found, which later tested positive for crack cocaine. Additionally, the vehicle he was driving had a fraudulent Illinois license plate. Before being taken away, Ortiz apologized for lying and said, It's what I do, I'm a criminal, and you're a cop. We have to do what's best for us. Frank Ortiz is charged for his warrant of possessing a stolen vehicle, along with a number of other vehicles and driving related offenses. He was also charged with possession of a controlled substance and obstructing identification. He is innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
